title: South Korea guides crowd-pulling shark out of canal

blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — A shark that has become a viral sensation in South Korea was coaxed out of a canal in which it was stuck, authorities said on Wednesday, as falling temperatures raised concerns for its survival.
